shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.0: Easy. You're among friends. We bound you up while you slept.
shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.1: Don't try to get up yet. The dressings need a day before they'll hold.
shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.2: You were near gone when they carried you in. Rest. The worst is bound.
shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.3: Lie still. I've washed it out with yarrow and wrapped it clean.
shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.stump.0: Lie still. We bound what was left of the limb tight. The bleeding's stopped.
shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.stump.1: I'm sorry. We couldn't save it, but we stopped the bleeding. A wooden one will serve, in time.
shelter.jaymoskingdoms.carer.stump.2: Easy now. The stump's bound and clean. You'll live, if you rest.
